text: Switched the double-click handlers to single click in Graph.tsx, Timeline.tsx, Zoom.tsx and the session table in App.tsx, removed the now-unused onSelect props, and added a ⤢ zoom-in button to reader rows (Zoom.tsx, styles.css) because a row click now expands instead. Typecheck and 57 unit tests pass, and the 30 Playwright checks in linked.mjs pass after their dblclick calls became click (one early failure came from a stale index, not this change). README.md and documentation/design.md wording is updated, and the work is committed as 33fac8e, not pushed.
